name: claude-for-adobe
title_zh: 在 Premiere 里直接对话剪辑，说句话它就动手
tagline_zh: 不用切窗口、不用记快捷键，像跟剪辑师说话一样让 AI 切掉静音、找台词、改结构。免费开源，装完就能在时间线上聊。
tagline_en: No window switching, no hotkeys—talk to your timeline like a human editor. Cut silences, find lines, restructure.
desc_en: Claude Code inside Premiere Pro. Talk to it about your timeline, let it cut, remove silences, ask what was said. Free, MIT, updated regularly. After Effects and Codex next.
why_zh: 把 Claude Code 接进 Premiere 的官方扩展，直接在时间线上理解上下文。
why_en: It embeds Claude Code into Premiere's UI, so the model sees your actual timeline and selection—not a blind API call.
limit_zh: 只支持 Premiere Pro（Mac 优先），需要本地装 Claude Code 和 Node.js。
limit_en: Premiere Pro only (Mac first), requires local Claude Code + Node.js. No After Effects/Codex yet. Can't handle complex multi-track sync or.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Talk to Premiere, it edits your timeline
